## Documentation-only evidence follow-up

Head `599bdafc8749ad69d1ffc1518f0239cf73e62aca` adds 30 lines only to `docs/releasing.md`. The reviewed production commit remains `d3d3e78c48c7b5004372c396f5483faaf40c2bed`; no deployment, installer, binary, build, runtime or source change. No new network probes or retests were run for this refresh.

The parent independently checked normal-host `curl --disable`, anonymously with no authorization, valid TLS and no `--resolve`:

| Path                 | Status | Body bytes |
| -------------------- | ------ | ---------- |
| `/`                  | 200    | 1604       |
| `/install.sh`        | 200    | 15983      |
| `/install.sh.sha256` | 200    | 77         |
| `/AGENTS.md`         | 404    | 0          |
| `/go.mod`            | 404    | 0          |

Installer SHA256 `d4e064cbc5d1df531697a03bf303d8bf241f3c8246e1f6382f1aa5c9214398fe` matches the served checksum. The initial negative DNS observation and `--resolve` proof remain preserved as historical evidence; normal-client transport now works.

Both old and intended repository `/releases/latest` endpoints still returned anonymous 404. Authenticated metadata remains private `ajnart/selfhost-skills`, default branch `main`; intended `ajnart/selfhost` returns 404. The parent recorded the normal-DNS follow-up on #295.

**These are transport and script-checksum reads, not installer execution or anonymous archive acceptance.** Artifact, rename, token-free install, self-update and publication holds remain. Keep this PR draft and unmerged. Repository visibility remains user-controlled.

Both independent final review axes pass with zero findings at 599bdafc8749ad69d1ffc1518f0239cf73e62aca. Standards verified the production diff is unchanged from reviewed d3d3e78c48c7b5004372c396f5483faaf40c2bed; Spec verified the 30-line normal-client followup preserves historical DNS evidence and does not overclaim installer/archive/update acceptance. These were read-only re-reviews, not new runtime tests. Keep draft and unmerged: repository rename, anonymous artifact distribution (#295), token-free install/old-binary redirect/self-update and publication remain held. Normal-client TLS and served-script checksum now pass only their stated transport gates.
